verdict.rationale: Shopify's Tap to Pay docs say it accepts contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay and digital wallets in person, on a phone over WiFi or cellular. Nothing in the evidence documents chip (EMV) acceptance, and a community comment (older) said the product still needed chip support. That covers the contactless and mobile-wallet parts but leaves the chip part unevidenced. missing for 10: documented chip/EMV card acceptance (e.g., card reader hardware), independent hands-on corroboration of contactless and wallet acceptance.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: Tap to Pay works with contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and digital wallets for fast and smooth checkouts.
Turn your smartphone into a checkout for on-the-go selling with Tap to Pay.
WiFi and cellular data connectivity let you take contactless payments
